props.gloss_en: the mishna: a gentile who comes to extinguish -- one does not say to him 'extinguish' nor 'do not extinguish'
R' Ami: in a fire they permitted saying 'whoever extinguishes will not lose'

a fire broke out in Yosef ben Simai's courtyard in Shichin; the men of the Tzippori garrison came to extinguish, for he was the king's steward, and he did not let them, because of the honour of Shabbat
a miracle happened for him: rain fell and extinguished [it]
in the evening he sent each of them two sela, and their commander fifty
the Sages: he did not need to [prevent them]
